facts.label: Present perfect com which
facts.sub: Use which + substantivo + have + sujeito + particípio: Which tour have you booked? Resposta: I have booked the cruise.

facts.label: Qual … você …?
facts.sub: Use which para escolher entre poucas opções: Which tour have you booked? Which seats have you booked? Depois de which vem o substantivo, depois have e o sujeito.

facts.label: já / ainda / acabei de
facts.sub: Already: I have already seen it. Yet: I haven’t received it yet. Just: I have just arrived. Já (already), ainda não (yet) e acabei de (just).

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Qual passeio você reservou?” e “Eu já vi o palácio”.
compare.us: Em inglês, use which + substantivo + have/has + sujeito + particípio: Which tour have you booked? Para respostas, use have + particípio: I have booked the cruise. Já = already, ainda não = yet.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

pages.title: A hotel lobby in London · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy morning in a London hotel. Ben walks into the lobby with a small bag. Dario works at the front desk. Many guests ask about tours. Ben has booked two tours online. He wants to check everything.

“Good morning! Which tour have you booked for this afternoon?” says Dario. “I have booked the river cruise, but I haven’t received the ticket yet.” says Ben. “Let me check. Which name have you used for the booking?” says Dario.
